findings.problem: The constructed baseline mapped U to Uii + U even when the selected process U already contained Uii, thereby double-counting the supplied component.
findings.resolution: Protocol v2 certifies that the selected target process excludes Uii before constructing the complete Uii + U mapping.

findings.problem: Identity-mapped observed states are initialized from their observed channel by the simulator, so the submitted fixed-zero mutation was behaviorally inert.
findings.resolution: Identity-mapped initialization is canonicalized deterministically and is not scored by the v2 LLM judge.

provenance_policy: The frozen v1 inputs and outputs remain unchanged as an auditable invalid experiment.
